product.name: Amazon Brand – Ravenna Home Living Room Recliner Chair, Leather, Brown
product.description: For living room, den, family room, or office, this brown leather recliner will suit a variety of decors. Use it in its upright position, or push back for a fully supported and relaxing experience. Overall: 32.5"W x 38"D x 41"H; arm height: 26"; seat depth; 20" Leather and foam over a strong metal mechanism; encased metal pocket coils for added comfort. Beautiful dark brown leather over dense foam make this recliner comfortable and attractive. Generously padded arms, seat, and back offer comfort, while full chaise recliners deliver optimal leg support. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Free returns for 30 days, 1-year warranty
